# ELK.js 0.11.0

`elk.bundled.js` is the unmodified browser/CommonJS bundle from the npm package
`elkjs@0.11.0` (`package/lib/elk.bundled.js`). It is committed so diagram layout
works without a CDN request or a build step on GitHub Pages.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/elkjs/v/0.11.0
Source: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs
License: Eclipse Public License 2.0; see ELK-LICENSE.md.
Tarball SHA-1: ca57b209ff66531c0f77ff32b9667aaeaad45d1b

For an update, obtain the explicitly selected package version, replace the
unmodified bundle and license, then run the graph, geometry and browser suites.
